mapper.sql: report.id, report.student_id, student.student_name, student_user.username AS student_account, report.class_organization_id, class_organization.organization_name AS class_name, report.reporter_user_id, reporter.display_name AS reporter_name, report.exception_type, report.content, report.status, report.handled_by, handler.display_name AS handler_name, report.reported_at, report.handled_at, report.version_no

FROM edu_exception_report report JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = report.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = report.class_organization_id JOIN sys_user reporter ON reporter.id = report.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user handler ON handler.id = report.handled_by
mapper.select: SELECT class_organization.id AS classOrganizationId, class_organization.organization_name AS className FROM edu_teacher_class teacher_class JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = teacher_class.class_organization_id WHERE teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY class_organization.organization_path, class_organization.sort_order, class_organization.id

SELECT id, student_id, class_organization_id, reporter_user_id, exception_type, content, status, idempotency_key, handled_by, handled_at, version_no, reported_at FROM edu_exception_report WHERE reporter_user_id = #{reporterUserId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_teacher_class teacher_class JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = teacher_class.class_organization_id JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.organization_id = teacher_class.class_organization_id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = student_class.student_id WHERE teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED')

SELECT student.id AS studentId, student.student_name AS studentName, student_user.username AS studentAccount FROM edu_teacher_class teacher_class JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = teacher_class.class_organization_id JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.organization_id = teacher_class.class_organization_id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = student_class.student_id AND student.status = 'ENABLED' LEFT JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id WHERE teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_exception_report (id, student_id, class_organization_id, reporter_user_id, exception_type, content, status, idempotency_key, version_no, reported_at) VALUES (#{report.id}, #{report.studentId}, #{report.classOrganizationId}, #{report.reporterUserId}, #{report.exceptionType}, #{report.content}, #{report.status}, #{report.idempotencyKey}, #{report.versionNo}, #{report.reportedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT action.id, action.action_type, action.operator_user_id, operator.display_name AS operator_name, action.before_status, action.after_status, action.action_note, action.created_at FROM edu_exception_report_action action JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = action.operator_user_id WHERE action.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY action.created_at, action.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_exception_report_action (id, report_id, action_type, operator_user_id, before_status, after_status, action_note, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{actionType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{actionNote}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO msg_local_event (id, event_type, business_type, business_id, recipient_type, recipient_id, content_summary, status, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, 'EXCEPTION_REPORT', #{businessId}, #{recipientType}, #{recipientId}, #{contentSummary}, 'PENDING', #{occurredAt})
